commands.name: stop-orbstack
commands.title: Stop OrbStack
commands.subtitle: Stops the OrbStack engine
commands.description: Stops the OrbStack engine (including all pods and containers)

commands.name: start-orbstack
commands.title: Start OrbStack
commands.subtitle: Runs the OrbStack runtime and docker engine

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
